MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, OCTOBER 10, 2024
  6201 APPIAN WAY
  LONG BEACH YACHT CLUB, 2:30 PM

Jo Murray, Chair  Gordana Kajer, Commissioner
Bruce Mac Rae, Vice Chair  Elizabeth Lambe, Commissioner
Avis Atkins McPhail, Commissioner  Theresa Marino, Commissioner
Elizabeth Carlin, Commissioner  Sabrina Zavala, Commissioner

  MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC HAVE THE OPTION TO EMAIL WRITTEN COMMENTS TO
  TAMALYN.SAYRE@LONGBEACH.GOV

CALL TO ORDER

ROLL CALL

REGULAR AGENDA

1.  24-55019  Recommendation to approve the minutes for the Marine Advisory Commission
  meeting of Thursday, September 12, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

2.  24-55170  Recommendation to support Council District Three’s referral of naming the new
  Junior Lifeguard Facility at the Claremont Small Boat Launch Ramp the “Pat Flynn
  and Dick Miller Junior Lifeguard Facility” to the Government Operations and
  Efficiency Committee for consideration.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

3.  24-55022  Recommendation to endorse the submission to authorize the City Manager, or
  designee, to approve a fee waiver for the California Army National Guard, in an
  amount not to exceed $355, for the use of Marine Stadium Park during the 224th
  Sustainment Brigade Best Warrior Competition on October 19, 2024. (District 3)

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

4.  24-55030  Recommendation to receive and file a Community Development presentation on
  PD-6 Downtown Shoreline area vision plan.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

5.  24-55031  Recommendation to receive and file a presentation on Lawn to Garden program in
  the Tidelands area.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

6.  24-55020  Recommendation to receive and file the Manager's monthly oral updates.

  Page 1 of 2
   MARINE ADVISORY COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, OCTOBER 10, 2024
  6201 APPIAN WAY
  LONG BEACH YACHT CLUB, 2:30 PM

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

7.  24-55021  Recommendation to receive and file the Committee status reports.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

PUBLIC COMMENT

Opportunity to address the Marine Advisory Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is
limited to three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Chair.

ANNOUNCEMENTS

ADJOURNMENT

I, Tamalyn Sayre, Bureau Secretary, certify that the agenda was posted not less than 72 hours prior
to the meeting.

NOTE: The agenda and supporting documents are available online at
https://longbeach.gov/cityclerk/meetings. If a special accommodation is desired pursuant to the
Americans with Disabilities Act, please contact the Marine Bureau office at (562) 570-3215 by noon
the day prior to the meeting.
